senses.gloss:
m. (-नः)
A king.
E.
भू the earth, and धन wealth.

m. (-रः)
1 A mountain.
2 A kind of chemical or medicinal apparatus; a sand bath in which a covered crucible is placed, and the fire is lighted above as well as below it.
E.
भू earth, धृ to support, aff. अप्.

m. (-ध्रः)
A mountain.
E.
भू the earth, धृ to hold, aff. अप्, and the vowel changed to its analogous semivowel.
